claim: Target document representation equality and ordered ranking agreement on a bounded sample under a fixed processor contract.
selection: Round-robin first unique image-byte SHA256 per collection in fixed collection order: 34/34/33/33/33/33. No outcomes used for selection.
queries: Original RandomState(0) 30% holdouts from five collections; exclude Shift as in corrected pooled analysis; 1033 expected. Ranking gallery is ONLY the selected 200 pages.
processor: Pinned base processor for all versions; vendor defaults are not tested. Persist input_ids, attention_mask, image_grid_thw and post-merger visual embeddings; reconstruct text embeddings and positions on target.
independence: Separate subprocesses for source capture and each target. Target raw calls native full forward with newly processed pixels; replay reads stored states, never raw prefix tensors.
measurements: per-page shape, finite check, equal elements, tensor equality, maximum absolute error
ordered top10 equality and set overlap with stable tie handling
paired raw page encoding and replay seconds including warm disk read, metadata reconstruction, transfers and output D2H; excludes model load, scoring, validation and serialization
scope: One A100, shared host, 200 source captures + 4x200 paired target endpoints; no fitting; approximately 30 GPU minutes plus load/scoring, contingent on page sizes.
